case.query: Ugh, the living room is so dim. Hard to read there. The bathroom feels really dry. My skin feels tight after washing and the mirror did not fog up like usual.

transcript.text: The plan will immediately set the available kids-room dimmable light to 100% brightness to help brighten nearby areas, and at the same time it will read the living room humidity to get a current measurement. It cannot directly control any living-room lights or change bathroom humidity because those devices are not available, so increasing bathroom humidity is not possible with this plan. Does this plan look good to you?
Done! The plan was executed successfully.
